changes: In variant A (tabs): use fewer tabs, grouped into 4 themes: Connections (where work is tracked, the live app), Updates, Add-ons (add-ons, kits and each part's own settings), This computer & advanced (this computer, the factory's programs). Make the selected tab much clearer: filled background and bold text, clearly different from the others.

In variant A: the selected tab looks weird. Style it like the selected page in the left sidebar (same text colour, weight and icon treatment), just without the background. Also: each part's own settings go under the "This computer & advanced" tab, not under Add-ons.

In variant A: (1) the selected tab gets a white background (like a card on the grey page), with dark text styled like the selected page in the left sidebar; the other tabs stay plain grey text, no background. (2) Split "This computer & advanced" into two tabs: "This computer" (this computer) and "Advanced" (the factory's programs and each part's own settings). So 5 tabs: Connections, Updates, Add-ons, This computer, Advanced.

The team still sees only 4 tabs in variant A on the board, although your screenshots show 5. Make sure the running prototype of variant A shows the latest version (5 tabs: Connections, Updates, Add-ons, This computer, Advanced; white selected tab), restarting it if needed, and check it in the running prototype.

things.text: 5 themed tabs: Connections, Updates, Add-ons, This computer, Advanced (the factory's programs and each part's own settings). The selected tab has a white background, with text like the selected page in the left sidebar.
